{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-de2853ab.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The zero gutter separates the template on the left from colored shapes.
    split = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h)))
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    separators = [r for r, row in enumerate(left) if all(v == bg for v in row)]
    bands = [(a + 1, b) for a, b in zip(separators, separators[1:]) if b > a + 1]

    # Extract each colored object in the right-hand panel as a connected component.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(split + 1, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if split < nx < w and 0 <= ny < h and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells); minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y-minr, x-minc) for y, x in cells)
            objects.append((color, shape))

    out = [row[:] for row in left]
    used = set()
    for start, end in bands:
        holes = [(r-start, c) for r in range(start, end) for c in range(split)
                 if grid[r][c] == 0]
        if not holes:
            continue
        minc = min(c for r, c in holes)
        shape = frozenset((r, c-minc) for r, c in holes)
        for i, (color, objshape) in enumerate(objects):
            if i not in used and objshape == shape:
                used.add(i)
                for dr, c in holes:
                    out[start+dr][c] = color
                break
    return out
"
}
